bio: Pille Senior and Junior work side by side in the kitchen of this elegant canteen in the picturesque village of Ramskapelle. In summertime, the terrace is very popular. The food is stripped back, handcrafted and traditional with a weakness for fish. Shrimp fritters, lobster belle vue and freshly prepared sabayon: delicate flavours that appeal time and time again. The fine wine list is fully in tune with this high-class establishment....
